author: Nerdstalgic
description:
The MCU didn’t collapse overnight.  It started with one small decision...opening Phase 4 with a Black Widow prequel.

Black Widow wasn’t just a late solo movie, it was a signal that Kevin Feige and Marvel Studios didn’t have a clear plan for what came next.

After the massive success of Avengers: Endgame, Marvel had a chance to reset, introduce new heroes, and define a bold new future.  Instead, they looked backward. And that decision set the entirety of Phase 4 off on the wrong foot.

#mcu #avengersendgame #avengersdoomsday #blackwidow #nerdstalgic
title: Marvel’s Biggest Post-Endgame Mistake
